text: The Bloom whispers differently tonight. Those who listen say it speaks in the old tongue.
The Convocation claims to have found a cure for bloom-touch. They need test subjects.
Convocation agents are meeting in the hollow caves every third night.
Three Convocation researchers defected to the Bureau last week with stolen notes.
The Convocation has been buying every scrap of bloom essence the scavengers can carry.
Their head seer hasn't spoken in a week. They say she saw the end and it broke her.
A relic stolen from the sealed vault is the key to their next ritual.
Pilgrims flock to the Hollow, certain the Bloom will grant them visions. Few return.
